headline: Oil Rises Above $115 per Barrel Following Inconclusive Israel Election
summary: Crude oil prices surged past $115 per barrel following inconclusive election results in Israel, where Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is expected to remain interim prime minister. The political gridlock fueled geopolitical uncertainty across the region.
why: Political instability in the Middle East directly influences global energy risk premiums and crude oil spot prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical uncertainty following Israel's inconclusive election added a risk premium to crude benchmark prices.

why_moved: Electoral uncertainty in Israel heightened fears of prolonged regional conflict and potential oil supply disruptions, pushing prices above $115.
